label: dense 'the' and phrase-initial
explanation: This dense feature fires on ~25% of all tokens, but its most reliable trigger is the token "the" (97% of occurrences), with other common function words, punctuation, and newlines firing at 30-40% and thus above the 24.7% baseline. It fires most strongly on "the" and on the first few tokens of a sequence or after prepositions/punctuation (i.e., at phrase/sentence starts), while weak firing is widespread later in text. It tends to stay silent on subword fragments, digits, spaces, and math symbols, though these can fire weakly at sequence starts.
